reviews.comment: He is overall an OK professor. I took him for COMM205 on online, a lot of work but not terrible. But doesn't answer to emails promptly and takes forever to respond. Claims that I never turned assignments in, when I have receipts of me turning them in. Avoid if this professor if you want someone who's willing to work with you.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Dr. Anderson is very good at helping students learn how to debate and provides constructive feedback. The class is made of 4 quizzes which are based on study guides he provides and 3 group debates with your team. The important thing is to attend class so we're there to observe debates. He is hard to reach by email, but an awesome class overall!

COMM407 was a great class. Professor Anderson asked great questions and always made each lecture entertaining. Your grade is based on essays every other week and a project at the end of the semester. Very kind grader. I definitely recommend his class.
was an online asynchronous class; workload was pretty condensed but assignments were pretty clear and straightforward in terms of both instructions and content; grading was done in a timely manner
Great Prof! Easy grader, just be respectful of his teachings. Only complaint is he isnt good at responding to emails.

Professor Anderson was super nice and would reply in a timely manner. The syllabus was not followed and due dates were constantly being switched around it was confusing. He grades based on his own opinion so it's very hard to get a good grade. Also, most of the assignments had nothing to do with the course.. I wouldn't recommend:/

Bro I'm gonna be honest... this whole class is a WTF moment because you literally never know WTF is going on. Due dates - always changed. A Republican? Your opinion to him is wrong. The work is easy, I will give him that, but your work is probs still not right. This is why I'm no longer a COMM major. This for the rest of my life? No thx! GOODLUCK!!

He has schedule posted on the syllabus, then he does not follow it. He grades unnecessarily hard especially because most of the points deducted are based off his opinion of your work, rather than grading on a rubric/your merit. His seems underprepared most of the time and most lectures have nothing to do with assignment. Would not take again.
He is a really nice professor.. but the instructions are not very clear on the assignments. Also it's extremely difficult to receive full credit on any assignments.

Chill guy and funny. Gets class debates going on certain topics which keeps it interesting. But LOVES to interrupt people in the middle of their sentence to tell them they're wrong and doesn't give them a chance to finish or reply... Overall easy A. Takes attendance, Quiz every 3 wks, Group presentations are most of the grade, Textbook not needed
